overall_reason: A cursor presses 'Connect' (pressed tint at 1614 ms), then the label is replaced by 'Disconnect account' in one frame and the button grows 66 px at once, shoving 'Settings' 67 px right (the sweep's two MOT-003 hits at 1666 ms); the reset back to 'Connect' at 4002 ms has no visible cause.

score.reason: T-CONTINUITY fails on the demo's one beat because the label swaps whole in one frame with the button resizing around it; the press before the result passes.

findings.evidence: The sweep records the button's width jumping +66 px and 'Settings' jumping +67 px on x in one frame at 1666 ms; the stills show 'Connect' at 1614 ms and 'Disconnect account' at 2601 ms, and the button declares no width or label transition.
findings.before: The whole label is replaced and the button jumps to its new width.
findings.after: Keep 'connect' in place, bring in 'Dis' and 'account' as the changed spans, and grow the button to the measured width over the same transition so 'Settings' moves continuously (MOT-254, MOT-255).
findings.why: The change the demo shows is the button's new state, and a one-frame swap gives the viewer no motion to follow.

findings.evidence: The button reads 'Disconnect account' at 2601 ms and 'Connect' at 4002 ms, and the cursor has not moved between those stills.
findings.before: The button resets to 'Connect' with no second press.
findings.after: Press 'Disconnect account' to reset, or hide the reset.
findings.why: An account that disconnects itself reads as a fault.

strengths: The press shows before the result: the 1614 ms still has the button's pressed tint before the label changes (MOT-256).
